description: Marks the person as away (vacation, leave) from a date to a date, inclusive, so Standcast stops sending them daily reminders and leaves them off the missing list on those days. It only marks the person themselves. Before calling, you MUST confirm the exact dates with the person. from is optional and defaults to today; until is the last away day. At most 90 days, and it cannot overlap another active period.

from.description: First away day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

org.description: Organization login. Optional when the person belongs to a single organization.

name: standcast_away_mark
title: Mark myself away
